source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: The PDF has a real text layer (mixed with the diagonal icseboard.org watermark); text taken from it and checked line by line against the rendered page images. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2022 comes from the file name (…-260922-2022, i.e. 26-09-2022). No duration is printed. No marks are printed per question (only M.M:35); items carry editorial estimates (1 mark per Section A item and per Section B sub-part, 2 marks for IX and X), flagged on each question. Section B says 'Attempt any Four' of six questions (V–X). Page 5 is blank apart from the watermark. No school name printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
